rule: An older subscription.updated (active) must not overwrite the later subscription.updated (paused)
setup:
INSERT INTO customers VALUES ('ctm_1');
INSERT INTO subscriptions(subscription_id,subscription_status,customer_id,event_occurred_at) VALUES ('sub_1','trialing','ctm_1','2026-01-01')
invariant: SELECT subscription_status <> 'active' FROM subscriptions WHERE subscription_id='sub_1'
notes: SQL transliteration of the webhook handler; covers bounded SQL orders only, not HTTP or Stripe.

statements: INSERT INTO subscriptions(subscription_id,subscription_status,customer_id,event_occurred_at) VALUES ('sub_1','active','ctm_1','2026-02-01 10:00:00+00') ON CONFLICT (subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET subscription_status=excluded.subscription_status,event_occurred_at=excluded.event_occurred_at

INSERT INTO subscriptions(subscription_id,subscription_status,customer_id,event_occurred_at) VALUES ('sub_1','paused','ctm_1','2026-02-02 10:00:00+00') ON CONFLICT (subscription_id) DO UPDATE SET subscription_status=excluded.subscription_status,event_occurred_at=excluded.event_occurred_at
